## Orientation

One executor builds dashboard-launcher then dashboard-status-segment in ~/se-workflow on branch feat/watch-dashboard, one commit each. Share store and binary resolution in one place rather than copying it. The user's tmux prefix bindings d and D are taken; the user already has ~/.claude/statusline-command.sh, so the segment is appended by the user, not installed. Do not edit ~/.tmux.conf, ~/.claude, or any .artifacts directory. The untracked ~/se-workflow/.artifacts/ is a live contract copy: do not commit it.
